# Core Summary
A cinematic horror sequence set in a dark rainforest at dusk, following a young couple's peaceful moment on a river hut that turns into a terrifying struggle for survival against a gigantic water beast. The clip utilizes a multi-shot progression (4 shots) to build tension from calm to chaos. Shot 1 establishes the serene but unsettling setting with a slow push-in. Shot 2 cuts to a low angle revealing underwater tension. Shot 3 captures the violent eruption of the creature in slow motion. Shot 4 concludes with a frantic escape and a chilling direct stare from the beast.

# Scene
[shot1][00:00-00:04] Deep rainforest at dusk, dense canopy blocking most sky light. A small wooden hut stands on stilts above a flowing river stream. Dim warm lantern light glows on the hut's terrace, contrasting with the cool blue-black ambient tones of the jungle. Fog hovers low over the dark water. Wet wood textures reflect the lantern light.
[shot2][00:04-00:07] Low angle perspective near the river surface, looking up at the hut's underside. Murky water fills the lower frame. Shadows from the hut structure create geometric patterns on the water. Lighting is dim, dominated by the reflection of the lantern above and faint moonlight filtering through trees.
[shot3][00:07-00:11] The terrace deck level. Chaotic lighting from the flickering lantern and splashing water. Dark gray-black tones dominate. Water droplets freeze in mid-air due to slow-motion effect. Wood planks show stress and wetness.
[shot4][00:11-00:15] Dark jungle path behind the hut, dense vegetation blurring past. The river edge is visible in the background. Lighting is minimal, relying on rim light from the moon and the creature's glowing eyes. Fog thickens near the ground.

# Subjects Description
<ID_A>: Male, young adult, East Asian. Short black hair, wearing a dark damp t-shirt and cargo shorts. Barefoot. Skin has natural texture with visible moisture from humidity.
<ID_B>: Female, young adult, East Asian. Long dark hair tied back loosely, wearing a light-colored sleeveless top and shorts. Barefoot. Skin tone natural, illuminated by lantern light.
<ID_C>: Gigantic mammal-like water beast. Massive scale, dark gray-black scarred skin with wet reflections. Huge jaws with sharp teeth. Glowing eye reflections. No extra limbs; quadrupedal movement.
**Vocal Characteristics**: <ID_A> and <ID_B> produce high-pitched panicked screams. <ID_C> emits deep, resonant roars and heavy breathing sounds.

# Dynamic Narrative
[shot1][00:00-00:04] Wide vertical framing captures the wooden hut above the river. <ID_A> and <ID_B> sit on the terrace edge, legs hanging down, facing away from the camera towards the jungle. Camera slowly pushes forward with subtle handheld motion. Water flows gently beneath. Lantern light flickers slightly. Ambient insect sounds and soft flowing water create a calm but uneasy baseline.
[shot2][00:04-00:07] Cut to low angle at water level. Water surface begins vibrating visibly, ripples spreading rapidly outward from under the hut. <ID_C>'s gigantic dark silhouette moves beneath the murky water, displacing volume. Lantern light above flickers more intensely. Camera shakes slightly to mimic ground vibration. Deep underwater rumble sound effect rises in volume.
[shot3][00:07-00:11] <ID_C> explodes upward from the river beside the terrace, water spraying violently in slow motion. <ID_C> opens massive jaws, teeth visible. <ID_A> and <ID_B> instantly recoil, scrambling backward on the wood. <ID_A> grabs <ID_B>'s arm. Camera rapidly pulls backward with intense handheld shaking. Wood creaks loudly under <ID_C>'s weight. Loud splash and roar dominate audio.
[shot4][00:11-00:15] <ID_C> crawls aggressively onto the deck, wood cracking under pressure. <ID_A> and <ID_B> sprint away into the dark jungle background. Camera whips around 180 degrees to face <ID_C>. <ID_C> stops at the river edge, staring directly into the lens. Eyes glow faintly. Heavy breathing sound. Instant hard cut to black as roar echoes.

# Style, Color & Aesthetics
Ultra-realistic 4K cinematic horror aesthetic. Moody blue-black color grading with high contrast between deep shadows and dim lantern highlights. Anamorphic lens look with slight lens flares on water reflections. Natural skin texture, no smoothing. Handheld cinematic camera movement creates grounded realism. Lighting is low-key, utilizing practical lantern sources and moonlight for rim lighting to maintain depth in dark areas. No bright colors; palette restricted to dark greens, blacks, grays, and warm amber lantern light.

# Atmosphere & Emotion
Suspenseful pacing transitioning into sheer terror. The atmosphere shifts from peaceful isolation to claustrophobic danger. Grounded realism makes the threat feel tangible. The ending leaves a lingering sense of dread with the creature's direct eye contact.
